# Clay

> > Clay is a data enrichment and sales automation platform that combines AI-powered workflows, lead generation, and personalized outbound campaigns to help GTM teams scale revenue operations.

Clay integrates with 75+ data providers (including Apollo, Lusha, Ocean.io) and CRMs to automate prospect research, enrich company and contact data, and generate personalized outreach at scale. The platform serves GTM teams globally with coverage across EMEA, Europe, and emerging markets.

## Key Topics

- Data enrichment and lead generation
- AI-powered sales automation
- Outbound sales and prospecting
- GTM engineering workflows
- CRM enrichment (Salesforce, Pipedrive)
- Clay Chrome Extension
- AI copywriting and personalization
- Account research and qualification
- Workflow templates and formulas
- Integration partners: Apollo, Lusha, Ocean.io, Beauhurst
- Clay University training
- European and EMEA coverage
- Sales follow-up automation
- Gong conversation intelligence
